sources.title: Apple gains smartphone share as memory crunch squeezes budget Android phones
sources.snippet: Apple's share of US smartphone shipments jumped to 57% in the third quarter from 50% a year earlier as rising memory costs squeezed makers of budget Android phones, according to Counterpoint Research.

sources.title: PROPEL Center Names University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff Winner of the Future of XYZ HBCU Innovation Challenge at AfroTech
sources.snippet: PROPEL Center announced that the University of Arkansas at Pine Bluff (UAPB) won the inaugural Future of XYZ HBCU Innovation Challenge at AfroTech, earning the $15,000 top prize for Brix, a money coaching app built by Gen Z for Gen Z. The win capped PROPEL's newest HBCU innovation challenge, which put student founders on a national technology stage during AfroTech week in Houston.
